_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits mid Disbelief band in a documented coil; no ±2-point breaker is visible so HOLD is the skilled base-rate call until momentum and flows align.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: analyst explicitly HOLD/Disbelief; narrative flow drop is mildly constructive but silent on phase, so no clean directional agreement
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear_greed holds 55-62, BTC 30d stays near flat, funding subdued, and exchange netflow does not re-accelerate
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear_greed breaks <55 with VIX/dvol expansion and persistent extreme netflow, or clears 63 as btc_momentum_30d and etf_flows turn up together
